meta.name: contract-review
meta.description: Contract review skill that adds comment-based issue annotations without changing original text. Enforces a three-layer review (basic, business, legal), writes structured comments (issue type, risk reason, revision suggestion) with risk level encoded via reviewer name, and generates a contract summary, consolidated opinion, and Mermaid business flowchart (with rendered image). Output language must follow the contract’s language.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查合同并添加结构化批注与摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速审查合同条款并生成风险摘要
copy.tagline_en: Review contracts with structured annotations and summaries
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly review contract clauses and generate risk summaries

howto.what: 该技能让 Claude 审查合同时只加批注不改原文，按基础、商务、法律三层检查，输出合同概要、综合意见和业务流程图（含图片），语言跟随合同语言。
howto.when: 当用户上传 .docx 合同并请求审阅时触发；技能会自动解包文档，执行三层审阅并生成批注和报告。

say.text: 请用三层审阅法检查这份合同，只加批注。
say.note: 触发完整审阅流程并生成批注版合同。

say.text: 审完合同后，输出概要、综合意见和业务流程图。
say.note: 生成批注合同、概要、意见和流程图。

say.text: 这份合同有金额不一致，风险等级标一下。
say.note: 批注会按三个风险等级标记在审阅人名称中。

howto.what_en: Claude reviews contracts by adding comments only, without changing the text. It performs a three-layer review (basic, business, legal) and produces a summary, opinion, and Mermaid flowchart (with image). Output language matches contract.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user uploads a .docx contract and asks for review. The skill unpacks the document, performs the three-layer review, and generates comments and reports.

say_en.text: Please review this contract using the three-layer method, comments only.
say_en.note: Triggers the full review and generates an annotated version.

say_en.text: After review, output the summary, opinion, and business flowchart.
say_en.note: Generates annotated contract, summary, opinion, and flowchart.

say_en.text: This contract has an amount inconsistency; mark the risk level.
say_en.note: Comments will encode risk levels in the reviewer names.
